scientific_use: Label astronomical source islands before photometry; remove components below a supplied pixel count.

canonical_equations: Foreground=valid and value>threshold; 4/8-connected components inside each complete image; label=1+minimum row-major pixel index in component if size>=npixels, otherwise0.
input_contract: encoding=binary32-hex; images[B,H,W],valid[B,H,W] uint0/1; B1..128,H/W1..32; B*H*W<=65536; scalar finite threshold; connectivity4 or8; npixels1..H*W.
output_contract: B x (H*W) uint32 labels;0 background; labels canonical but not necessarily consecutive; no deblending or cross-image component merging.
result_contract: B x (H*W) uint32 labels;0 background; labels canonical but not necessarily consecutive; no deblending or cross-image component merging.
precision_requirements: Preserved finite binary32 comparisons; exact uint32 component labels. No arithmetic quantization or numeric label tolerance.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.
reference_implementation: science_library/space_statistics_reference.py + f32.py (Fraction oracle; independent flood fill for labels)
